001: Hello Mr. Dupont, do you have a moment?
Of course, Camille. Come in and close the door, please.
Thank you. It's about my dissertation.
I read it. The topic is well chosen, but it lacks concrete examples.
You're right. I'm going to add examples to support my arguments.
That's a good idea. Come back and see me when you're done.
002: Hello, I came to ask you a question about the course.
I'm listening, Léa. What is it about?
I didn't understand the concept of globalization.
It's a complex subject. We can talk about it together if you want.
That would be very kind. Can I come by tomorrow afternoon?
Yes, tomorrow at three o'clock works perfectly for me.
003: Sir, I wanted to talk to you about my grade on the last exam.
I see, you weren't happy with your result?
No, I was a bit disappointed, I thought I had done better.
You got fourteen out of twenty, that's a good grade though.
That's true, but I thought I had understood the course.
Listen, if you want, we can go over your mistakes together.
004: Hello, I'd like to change the topic for my thesis.
Oh really? You told me you liked your topic.
Yes, but I find it too broad now.
We can refocus it on a more specific question.
That's exactly what I wanted to suggest.
Very well, bring me your new ideas next week.
005: Sorry to bother you, I have an urgent question.
No problem, Hugo. What is it about?
I don't understand the instructions for the next assignment.
You have to analyze a text and write a summary.
Okay, and when is it due?
By next Friday, at noon at the latest.
006: Hello, I wanted to thank you for your advice.
You're welcome, it's my job to help students.
Thanks to you, I finally understood the subject.
I'm glad to hear that. You've made progress.
Thank you very much, I'll keep working seriously.
I don't doubt it. Good luck with the rest.
007: Sir, I'm a bit lost about my career path.
That's an important question. Do you have any leads?
I'm hesitating between continuing with a master's degree or looking for a job.
It's a difficult decision, but you have time to think about it.
You're right, but I'm afraid of making the wrong choice.
We can discuss it more at length if you want.
008: Hello, I wanted to know if you had read my outline.
Yes, I looked at it this weekend. It's well structured.
Thank you. Do you have any comments for me?
The second part is a bit too short in my opinion.
I'll expand it with more details.
009: It's okay, but try to be on time next time.
Please forgive me, there was a transportation problem.
I understand, it happens. Let's sit down.
Thank you. I wanted to show you my latest results.
Alright, let's look at them together.
010: Hello, I wanted to ask you for an extension on my assignment.
An extension? Do you have a problem with the due date?
Yes, I have two other assignments due the same week.
I understand. You can turn it in two days later.
Thank you very much, that's very kind of you.
You're welcome, but don't make a habit of asking for extensions.
